name: Wool scarf
description: A long knitted wool scarf in red, banded in cream near each fringed end.
notes: Folded in four into a 300 x 200 mm stack with one end lying out on the floor: knitted ribs along its length, two cream bands and a tasselled fringe. Slot `face` as the bandanas and other cloths worn over the mouth in earlier batches. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Wool scarf (headwrap)
description: A long knitted wool scarf wound over the head and across the mouth.
notes: A worn state of the wool scarf: folded on a shelf it looks the same, so it shares the `scarf` model. Deadvox has no field for switching between worn states, so it is drafted as its own item; it may fold into the wool scarf once such a toggle exists. Slot `hood` as the headscarves in earlier batches, since wrapped over the head it sits under a hat or helmet. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Long wool scarf
description: A very long knitted wool scarf in red, banded in cream near each fringed end, long enough to wind round twice and tuck the hands into.
notes: Folded in eight into a 340 x 220 mm stack twice as tall as the short scarf's, with one end trailing 420 mm out along the floor so it reads apart from the short one; ribbed, banded and fringed like the wool scarf. The bounding box takes in the long end lying out on the floor. Slot `face` as the bandanas and other cloths worn over the mouth in earlier batches. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
